answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 42386 Country: India Title: It is lawful to use homeopathic medicine as it contains alcohol? Question: It is lawful to use homeopathic medicine as it contains alcohol? Answer ID: 42386 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1111/1113/N=1433) The quantity of alcohol is very less in homeopathic medicines and now many alcohols are made of potato, vegetables and coals etc; hence you can use homeopathic medicines for treatment. It is lawful as per the Shariah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
